notes.title: Update Notes, November '26
notes.content: This update introduces the one and only Ms. Sneezeman, improved tutorial features, country flags, multiple quality of life features, improved playability and more. Bless you! Team Sneezeman. Look out for multiplayer, new worlds and more characters coming soon…

notes.title: Update Notes, July '24
notes.content: This update introduces missions, achievements, giant BOSS battles, a sneeze cannon, multiple quality of life features, improved playability and more. Bless you! Team Sneezeman. Look out for multiplayer, coming soon…

notes.title: Update Notes, March '23
notes.content: This update introduces multiple quality of life features, including a new world map, improved playability and more! Bless you! Team Sneezeman. More updates coming soon…

notes.title: Update Notes, September 04
notes.content: This update introduces multiple quality of life features, more fun, improved playability more sneezes, a wheel of fortune, secret caches, a Nyan Sneezeman and more! Bless you! Team Sneezeman. More updates coming soon…

notes.title: Update Notes, May '22.
notes.content: This update introduces multiple new quality of life features & bug fixes, more fun, a new mini-game ‘Test Your Sneeze’, checkpoints and an incredible new companion digital soundtrack album available now on all good streaming platforms. More updates coming soon. Bless You! Team Sneezeman.
